task: Predict whether a U.S. resident younger than 65 with personal income at or below $30,000 is covered by public health insurance.
label: label

columns.name: AGEP
columns.description: Age in completed years for a person younger than 65. Relevance to the task: Age is strongly related to eligibility for public insurance programs and health-care needs.

columns.name: SCHL
columns.description: Highest level of education completed. Relevance to the task: Education can reflect employment opportunities, income stability, and access to employer-sponsored insurance. Codes: 1=no schooling completed; 2=nursery school or preschool; 3=kindergarten; 4=grade 1; 5=grade 2; 6=grade 3; 7=grade 4; 8=grade 5; 9=grade 6; 10=grade 7; 11=grade 8; 12=grade 9; 13=grade 10; 14=grade 11; 15=12th grade without diploma; 16=high school diploma; 17=GED or alternative credential; 18=some college, less than one year; 19=one or more years of college credit, no degree; 20=associate degree; 21=bachelor's degree; 22=master's degree; 23=professional degree beyond bachelor's; 24=doctorate degree.

columns.name: MAR
columns.description: Current marital status. Relevance to the task: Marital status may affect household resources, dependency status, and insurance access. Codes: 1=married; 2=widowed; 3=divorced; 4=separated; 5=never married or younger than 15.

columns.name: SEX
columns.description: Sex category recorded in the ACS. Relevance to the task: Insurance eligibility and health-service use can differ across recorded sex categories. Codes: 1=male; 2=female.

columns.name: DIS
columns.description: Whether the person reports any disability. Relevance to the task: Disability is directly relevant to Medicaid and other public coverage eligibility pathways. Codes: 1=has a disability; 2=does not have a disability.

columns.name: ESP
columns.description: Employment status of the parent or parents with whom the person lives. Relevance to the task: Parental employment can indicate household income and availability of employer-sponsored insurance. Codes: 0=not applicable; 1=two parents, both in labor force; 2=two parents, father only in labor force; 3=two parents, mother only in labor force; 4=two parents, neither in labor force; 5=father present and in labor force; 6=father present and not in labor force; 7=mother present and in labor force; 8=mother present and not in labor force.

columns.name: CIT
columns.description: Citizenship and place-of-birth status. Relevance to the task: Citizenship status can affect eligibility for some public insurance programs. Codes: 1=born in the United States; 2=born in Puerto Rico or another U.S. island area; 3=born abroad to U.S.-citizen parent or parents; 4=U.S. citizen by naturalization; 5=not a U.S. citizen.

columns.name: MIG
columns.description: Whether the person lived in the same house, elsewhere in the U.S., or abroad one year ago. Relevance to the task: Recent mobility may indicate changes in employment, household structure, or program enrollment. Codes: 1=same house as one year ago; 2=lived outside the United States or Puerto Rico; 3=different house in the United States or Puerto Rico.

columns.name: MIL
columns.description: Current or previous military service status. Relevance to the task: Military service can provide access to military or veterans' health coverage, affecting public coverage status. Codes: 0=not applicable, generally younger than 17; 1=currently on active duty; 2=previously on active duty but not now; 3=active duty only for Reserve or National Guard training; 4=never served in the military.

columns.name: ANC
columns.description: Whether one, multiple, unclassified, or no ancestry responses were reported. Relevance to the task: This may capture demographic differences correlated with socioeconomic conditions and insurance access. Codes: 1=single ancestry reported; 2=multiple ancestries reported; 3=ancestry unclassified; 4=ancestry not reported.

columns.name: NATIVITY
columns.description: Whether the person is native-born or foreign-born. Relevance to the task: Nativity can be associated with citizenship, employment, and eligibility for public insurance. Codes: 1=native-born; 2=foreign-born.

columns.name: DEAR
columns.description: Whether the person has serious difficulty hearing. Relevance to the task: Hearing difficulty is a disability-related factor that may increase eligibility or need for public coverage. Codes: 1=yes; 2=no.

columns.name: DEYE
columns.description: Whether the person has serious difficulty seeing, even with glasses. Relevance to the task: Vision difficulty is a disability-related factor relevant to public insurance eligibility and health needs. Codes: 1=yes; 2=no.

columns.name: DREM
columns.description: Whether the person has difficulty remembering, concentrating, or making decisions. Relevance to the task: Cognitive difficulty is a disability-related factor that may affect program eligibility and care needs. Codes: 1=yes; 2=no.

columns.name: PINCP
columns.description: Total personal income. Negative values indicate a net loss; the task includes income up to $30,000. Relevance to the task: Income is one of the strongest determinants of eligibility for means-tested public insurance.

columns.name: ESR
columns.description: Current employment and labor-force status. Relevance to the task: Employment strongly affects income and access to employer-sponsored insurance. Codes: 0=not applicable, generally younger than 16; 1=civilian employed and at work; 2=civilian employed with a job but not at work; 3=unemployed; 4=armed forces and at work; 5=armed forces with a job but not at work; 6=not in labor force.

columns.name: FER
columns.description: Whether the person gave birth within the past 12 months. Relevance to the task: Recent childbirth may increase eligibility for pregnancy-related Medicaid or other public coverage. Codes: 0=not applicable; 1=yes; 2=no.

columns.name: RAC1P
columns.description: Race category recorded in the ACS. Relevance to the task: Race may capture structural differences in income, employment, health needs, and insurance access. Codes: 1=White alone; 2=Black or African American alone; 3=American Indian alone; 4=Alaska Native alone; 5=specified American Indian or Alaska Native tribal category; 6=Asian alone; 7=Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander alone; 8=some other race alone; 9=two or more races.

columns.name: label
columns.description: Binary prediction target: 0 means not covered by public health insurance; 1 means covered by public health insurance.
